title: Device family (contract 1)
description: devices/families/<id>.json: what every board of one chip family shares in its download mode (recovery method, entry steps, USB vendor, family-wide flash rules, host driver, chip names per PID). A board record names its family with "family" and omits what the family gives; its own facts (usb_boot, recovery.flash, storage_target) stay in the record.

method.description: The recovery method every board of the family gets when its record omits recovery.method.

entry.description: Generic download-mode steps: the default recovery.instructions of the family's boards. A record's own instructions replace them.

flash.description: Family-wide flash rules, data only: the stages Atlas runs and what it checks. A board's own flash facts (loader, storage, image_offset, load_address, nand) stay in its record's recovery.flash.

loader_chips.description: rockusb: the chip tags a loader may report (the four characters a chip-info or loader header carries, as reversed ASCII), keyed by the record's SoC name. A loader or chip reply outside a board's list stops the flash.

fel_image.description: allwinner-fel: the image form the family can load.

sram.description: FEL: the SRAM layout the thunk and SPL use (crates/atlas-socflash/src/fel/layout.rs reads it). Null until an SoC's layout is sourced; Atlas runs nothing without it.

host.description: How a host sees the family's devices: the driver or rule that matches it, per host OS.

eeprom.description: The family's bootloader images (paths relative to devices/families/<id>/): a board's own eeprom block adds to and overrides these by role.

pid_chips.description: The chip a download-mode PID stands for, keyed by the USB product id as four hex digits. A PID not listed names no chip.

sram.description: An SoC's FEL SRAM layout, as data. Addresses are 0x-prefixed 32-bit hex strings. swap_buffers pairs each live FEL stack region (buf1) with a free backup (buf2) of the same size; the thunk swaps them around the SPL call. The thunk and the SPL must not overlap a swap buffer.

load_address.description: Where the SPL is written and entered (SRAM).

thunk_address.description: Where the thunk blob is written and run (SRAM, outside every swap buffer).

uboot_address.description: Where the legacy U-Boot image is written and entered (DRAM, after the SPL).

buf1.description: A live FEL stack region in SRAM.

buf2.description: A free backup area of the same size.

status.description: UNCONFIRMED when the layout is not yet checked on a board.
